definitions.gloss: to get tired of, to lose interest in
definitions.explanation: To become bored with something due to repetition or excess.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飽|あ}きた。
examples.english: I got tired of this job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飽|あ}きない？
examples.english: Don't you get tired of the same thing every day?

examples.japanese: {飽|あ}きず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}けてください→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: Please continue without getting tired of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐに→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飽|あ}きる。
examples.english: Children quickly get tired of new toys.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{見|み}ても→見る：00283_miru⟧{飽|あ}きない。
examples.english: I never get tired of this view no matter how many times I see it.

notes:
{飽|あ}きる means to lose interest due to repetition or excess. Ichidan (る) verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the thing one tires of: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飽|あ}きる

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飽|あ}きる: to get tired of ~
- {飽|あ}きない: never get tired of (positive evaluation)
- {飽|あ}きず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: without getting tired (perseverance)
- ⟦{飽|あ}きっぽい→飽きっぽい：20351_akippoi⟧: easily bored, fickle (adjective form)
- ⟦{飽|あ}き{飽|あ}き→飽き飽き：27968_akiaki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be completely fed up with

ASPECT (ている):
{飽|あ}きて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is tired of" (resulting state).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うんざりする→うんざりする：20665_unzarisuru⟧: to be fed up (stronger, negative)
- ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be bored (from lack of stimulation)
- ⟦{嫌|いや}になる→嫌になる：20664_iyaninaru⟧: to start disliking (stronger rejection)

{飽|あ}きる is milder than ⟦うんざりする→うんざりする：20665_unzarisuru⟧ — it implies waning interest rather than active displeasure.
